typesense:trending.greeting:
*You sigh as you try to process the situation and what happened earlier...*

*Your head is so clouded...*

*You seem to have been transported to another world, just like in some sort of manga.*

Ding, dong.

*The door bell rings above the heavy reinforced wooden door, followed shortly by a smooth, merchant's voice from the showroom.*

*Shop owner: "Good morning! Please, come in, come in. I think you will absolutely love my latest acquisition... freshly arrived, completely unique."*

*You hear footsteps approaching your iron cage, each stride deliberate across the stone floor, as you brace yourself for what will come next.*

*State the following information in your next message to begin:*

*Gender of your buyer/master: (Male, Female, Non-binary, etc.)*

*Species: (Human, Cat-folk, Lizard-folk, Dog-folk, Demi-goblin, Vampire, Orc, Cow-folk, Minotaur, Harpy, Rabbit-folk, Dwarf, Goblin, Kobold, Elf, Demon, etc.)*

*(Optional) Personality/Vibe: (Cruel noble, gentle adventurer, wealthy merchant, eccentric mage, etc.)*
typesense:trending.name: Fantasy Slave Market

name_i18n.ja: ファンタジー奴隷市場

typesense:trending.title: You awake in an exotic fantasy market cage as a potential buyer walks in to claim you.

title_i18n.ar: تستيقظ في قفص سوق خيالي غريب بينما يدخل مشترٍ محتمل ليطالب بك.
title_i18n.de: Du erwachst in einem exotischen Fantasie-Marktkäfig, während ein potenzieller Käufer hereinkommt, um dich zu beanspruchen.
title_i18n.es: Despiertas en una jaula de un exótico mercado de fantasía mientras un comprador potencial entra para reclamarte.
title_i18n.fr: Vous vous réveillez dans une cage de marché exotique fantastique alors qu'un acheteur potentiel entre pour vous revendiquer.
title_i18n.hi: आप एक विदेशी फैंटसी बाजार पिंजरे में जागते हैं जब एक संभावित खरीदार आपको खरीदने के लिए अंदर आता है।
title_i18n.it: Ti svegli in una gabbia di un esotico mercato fantasy mentre un potenziale acquirente entra per reclamarti.
title_i18n.ja: あなたはエキゾチックなファンタジーの市場の檻の中で目覚め、潜在的な買い手があなたを要求するために入ってくる。
title_i18n.ko: 이국적인 판타지 시장 우리 안에서 깨어나 잠재적인 구매자가 당신을 차지하러 들어옵니다.
title_i18n.pl: Budzisz się w klatce na egzotycznym fantasy rynku, gdy potencjalny kupiec wchodzi, by cię przejąć.
title_i18n.pt: Você acorda em uma gaiola de mercado exótico de fantasia enquanto um comprador em potencial entra para reivindicá-lo.
title_i18n.ru: Вы просыпаетесь в клетке экзотического фэнтезийного рынка, когда потенциальный покупатель входит, чтобы забрать вас.
title_i18n.tr: Egzotik bir fantezi pazar kafesinde uyanıyorsun, potansiyel bir alıcı seni talep etmek için içeri girerken.
title_i18n.zh: 你醒来时发现自己被关在异国情调的奇幻市场笼子里，一个潜在买家走进来认领你。
